```{r load-data}

load("~/Desktop/Projects/2025_05_19_TBI_SCI_BDTau/Processed_Data/tbi_sci_cntr_cleaned.RData")

# matched baseline

intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned),
  names(tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned)
))

match_baseline_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    sci_match_demo_BL_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_match_demo_BL_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("SCI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI"))) %>%
  mutate(Cohort2 = factor(case_when(Cohort %in% c("SCI") ~ Cohort, 
                                    TRUE ~ "TBI"), 
                          levels = c("SCI","TBI")))

```

```{r figure 1}
p_serum <- ggplot(serum_df, aes(x = Cohort2, y = mean_serum_log2_BDTau, fill = Cohort2, color = Cohort2)) +

  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(BD-Tau)", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  ) +
  # pairwise p-values (stars); hide non-sig if you want
  ggpubr::stat_pvalue_manual(
    dunn_res,
    label = "p.adj.signif",
    xmin = "group1",
    xmax = "group2",
    y.position = "y.position",
    tip.length = 0.01,
    step.increase = 0.0,
    bracket.size = 0.4,
    size = 6,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  # Omnibus p-value annotation at the top-right
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = Inf, y = max(dunn_res$y.position, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.8 * step,
    label = paste0("Kruskal-Wallis p = ", signif(kw_res$p, 3)),
    hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 3.6
  ) + 
  ylim(1,12.5)

dunn_res %>%
  mutate(
    p_formatted = ifelse(p < 0.001,

                        sprintf("%.3f", p)),
    p.adj_formatted = ifelse(p.adj < 0.001,

                            sprintf("%.3f", p.adj))
  ) %>%
  select(group1, group2, n1, n2, statistic, p_formatted, p.adj_formatted, p.adj.signif) %>%
  kable(
    col.names = c("Group 1", "Group 2", "N1", "N2", "Statistic", "P-value", "Adjusted P", "Sig."),
    caption = "Pairwise Dunn's Test Results for Serum BD-Tau (log2) by Cohort",
    align = c('l', 'l', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c', 'c')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
    full_width = FALSE,
    position = "left"
  )
```

```{r figure 2a}

# Spearman Correlation: Serum vs CSF BD-Tau

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(patchwork)
library(gt)
library(writexl)

# ============================================
# PREPARE MATCHED COHORT DATA
# ============================================

match_df <- match_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), 
         !is.na(mean_serum_BDTau), 
         !is.na(mean_csf_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")),
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    )
  )

# ============================================
# SPEARMAN CORRELATION ANALYSIS
# ============================================

# Helper function to calculate Spearman CI using Fisher's Z transformation
spearman_ci <- function(x, y, conf.level = 0.95, digits = 2) {
  test_result <- cor.test(x, y, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  rho <- as.numeric(test_result$estimate)
  n <- sum(complete.cases(x, y))

  # Fisher's Z transformation
  z <- 0.5 * log((1 + rho) / (1 - rho))
  se <- 1 / sqrt(n - 3)
  z_crit <- qnorm((1 + conf.level) / 2)

  # CI on Z scale
  z_lower <- z - z_crit * se
  z_upper <- z + z_crit * se

  # Transform back
  ci_lower <- (exp(2 * z_lower) - 1) / (exp(2 * z_lower) + 1)
  ci_upper <- (exp(2 * z_upper) - 1) / (exp(2 * z_upper) + 1)

  list(
    estimate = rho,
    conf.int = c(ci_lower, ci_upper),
    p.value = test_result$p.value,                         # numeric (for stats)
    p.value_sci = formatC(test_result$p.value,             # formatted (for reporting)
                          format = "e",
                          digits = digits),
    n = n
  )
}


# Overall correlation
cor_overall <- spearman_ci(match_df$mean_serum_BDTau, 
                           match_df$mean_csf_BDTau)

# By cohort

cor_sci <- spearman_ci(
  match_df$mean_serum_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "SCI"],
  match_df$mean_csf_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "SCI"]
)

cor_tbi <- spearman_ci(
  match_df$mean_serum_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "TBI"],
  match_df$mean_csf_BDTau[match_df$Cohort2 == "TBI"]
)

# Summary statistics by cohort

correlation_by_cohort <- match_df %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Serum_Mean = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Serum_SD = sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Serum_Median = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Mean = mean(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_SD = sd(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Median = median(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(correlation_by_cohort)

# Summary by subgroup
correlation_by_subgroup <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3)) %>%
  group_by(Cohort3) %>%
  summarise(
    N = n(),
    Serum_Mean = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    CSF_Mean = mean(mean_csf_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    Spearman_rho = cor(mean_serum_BDTau, mean_csf_BDTau, method = "spearman"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(correlation_by_subgroup)

# ============================================
# PUBLICATION TABLE
# ============================================

# Create comprehensive correlation table
correlation_summary <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Overall", "SCI", "TBI"),
  N = c(cor_overall$n, cor_sci$n, cor_tbi$n),
  Spearman_rho = c(cor_overall$estimate, cor_sci$estimate, cor_tbi$estimate),
  CI_Lower = c(cor_overall$conf.int[1], cor_sci$conf.int[1], cor_tbi$conf.int[1]),
  CI_Upper = c(cor_overall$conf.int[2], cor_sci$conf.int[2], cor_tbi$conf.int[2]),
  P_value = c(cor_overall$p.value, cor_sci$p.value, cor_tbi$p.value)
)

# Format for publication
correlation_summary_formatted <- correlation_summary %>%
  mutate(
    `Spearman ρ (95% CI)` = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", 
                                    Spearman_rho, CI_Lower, CI_Upper),
    `P-value` = ifelse(P_value < 0.001, "<0.001", 
                       sprintf("%.3f", P_value))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Group, N, `Spearman ρ (95% CI)`, `P-value`)

print(correlation_summary_formatted)

# Create gt table
correlation_gt <- correlation_summary_formatted %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = md("**Serum-CSF BD-Tau Correlation**"),
    subtitle = "Matched Cohort Analysis (Baseline)"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    Group = "Group",
    N = "N",
    `Spearman ρ (95% CI)` = "Spearman ρ (95% CI)",
    `P-value` = "P-value"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = 12,
    heading.title.font.size = 14
  ) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = "Spearman rank correlation on raw BD-Tau values (pg/mL)",
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = `Spearman ρ (95% CI)`)
  )

# ============================================
# VISUALIZATION: SCATTER PLOT
# ============================================

# Define colors
cohort_colors <- c("SCI" = "#07668d", "TBI" = "#813405")

# Main scatter plot with log scales
p_correlation <- ggplot(match_df, aes(x = mean_serum_BDTau, y = mean_csf_BDTau)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cohort2), shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1) +

  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10",

  scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10",
                     breaks = c(100, 300, 1000, 3000, 10000, 30000)) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "bl") +
  labs(
    title = "Serum-CSF BD-Tau Correlation",
    x = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    y = "CSF BD-Tau (pg/mL)",
    color = "Cohort"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)
  )

print(p_correlation)

# Faceted by cohort
p_by_cohort <- ggplot(match_df %>% mutate(Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("TBI","SCI"))), aes(x = mean_serum_BDTau, y = mean_csf_BDTau)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Cohort2), shape = 1, size = 2, alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
```

```{r figure 2 bcde}
# ============================================
# Matched Serum/CSF Cohort Visualization
# ============================================

library(rstatix)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)

# Color palette
integrated_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "B-D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Mild TBI" = "#f8dda4",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

cntr_tbi_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
  )

cntr_sci_color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50", 
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd"
  )

integrated_3color_palette <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "SCI" = "#07668d",
  "TBI" = "#813405"
)

match_df <- match_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = names(integrated_3color_palette))) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("Control", "C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    ),
    Cohort4 = factor(case_when(
      Cohort3 %in% c("B SCI", "C/D SCI") ~ "B-D SCI",
      Cohort3 == "A SCI" ~ "A SCI",
      TRUE ~ Cohort3),
      levels = c("Control","B-D SCI","A SCI","Moderate TBI","Severe TBI"))
  )

csf_df <- csf_baseline_cleaned %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = names(integrated_3color_palette))) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids  ~ "A SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids  ~ "B SCI",
      Cohort2 == "SCI" & !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort3 = factor(
      Cohort3,
      levels = c("Control", "C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")
    ),
    Cohort4 = factor(case_when(
      Cohort3 %in% c("B SCI", "C/D SCI") ~ "B-D SCI",
      Cohort3 == "A SCI" ~ "A SCI",
      TRUE ~ Cohort3),
      levels = c("Control","B-D SCI","A SCI","Moderate TBI","Severe TBI"))
  )

# ============================================
# DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================

# Filter to only complete cases for 2-group analysis
match_df_2group <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort2), 
         !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau),
         !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(Cohort2 = factor(Cohort2, levels = c("SCI", "TBI")))

# Check sample sizes
cat("Sample sizes for 2-group analysis:\n")
print(table(match_df_2group$Cohort2))
cat("\n")

fc_df <- match_df_2group %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    serum_median = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    csf_median   = median(mean_csf_BDTau,   na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    serum_FC = serum_median[Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
               serum_median[Cohort2 == "SCI"],
    csf_FC = csf_median[Cohort2 == "TBI"] /
               csf_median[Cohort2 == "SCI"],
    serum_log2FC = log2(serum_FC),
    csf_log2FC = log2(csf_FC)
  )

fc_df

# Filter for 5-group analysis
match_df_5group <- match_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3),
         !is.na(mean_serum_log2_BDTau),
         !is.na(mean_csf_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  mutate(Cohort3 = factor(Cohort3, 
                          levels = c("C/D SCI", "B SCI", "A SCI", 
                                     "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
         Cohort4 = factor(Cohort4, 
                          levels = c("B-D SCI","A SCI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")))

# Check sample sizes
cat("Sample sizes for 5-group analysis:\n")

# ============================================

# ============================================

# --------------------------------------------
# Panel A: Serum SCI vs TBI (2-group)
# --------------------------------------------

# Get summary by cohort
serum_match_summary_2group <- match_df_2group %>%
  group_by(Cohort2) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_BDTau = mean(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_BDTau = sd(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_BDTau = median(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_BDTau = quantile(mean_serum_BDTau, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_BDTau = quantile(mean_serum_BDTau, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_BDTau = min(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_BDTau = max(mean_serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Statistical comparison - Mann-Whitney U test
wilcox_res_serum <- match_df_2group %>% 
  wilcox_test(mean_serum_log2_BDTau ~ Cohort2, alternative = "two.sided") %>%
  add_significance("p")

W <- unname(wilcox_res_serum$statistic)
p <- wilcox_res_serum$p

W; p

y_max_serum_2g <- max(match_df_2group$mean_serum_log2_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE)

# Panel A: Serum SCI vs TBI
p_serum_2group <- ggplot(match_df_2group, aes(x = Cohort2, y = mean_serum_log2_BDTau, 
                                              fill = Cohort2, color = Cohort2)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.62, alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = 3, 
               outlier.color = "red", color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, shape = 1, alpha = 0.65, show.legend = FALSE) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar", width = 0.5, size = 0.45, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = integrated_3color_palette, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = integrated_3color_palette, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "log2(BD-Tau)", title = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13)
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = list(c("SCI", "TBI")),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.02,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    size = 6
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5, y = y_max_serum_2g + 0.5,
    label = paste0("Mann-Whitney U p = ", signif(wilcox_res_serum$p, 3)),
```

```{r figure 2f}
# =============================================
# Adjusted Logistic ROC: BD-Tau ~ Age + Sex
# =============================================

# Helper to automate section creation

run_pairwise_roc_section <- function(data, cohort_var, pairs, section_label,
                                     n_folds = 5, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  purrr::map_dfr(pairs, function(pair) {
    df <- data %>%
      rename(cohort = {{cohort_var}}) %>%
      filter(cohort %in% pair) %>%
      mutate(
        outcome = as.numeric(cohort == pair[2]),
        Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
      ) %>%
      drop_na(z_log2_serum_BDTau, Age, Sex, outcome)
    
    if (length(unique(df$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df$Sex)) < 2) {
      return(tibble(
        Section = section_label,
        Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
        AUC = NA, CI_Lower = NA, CI_Upper = NA,
        N_Reference = sum(df$outcome == 0),
        N_Positive = sum(df$outcome == 1),
        Cutpoint = NA, NPV = NA, PPV = NA,
        Sensitivity = NA, Specificity = NA,
        Accuracy = NA,
        AUC_CV = NA, SD_CV = NA,
        AUC_Boot = NA, CI_Lower_Boot = NA, CI_Upper_Boot = NA
      ))
    }
    
    # Fit full model
    model <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df, family = binomial())
    prob <- predict(model, type = "response")
    
    # Full ROC
    roc_obj <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, prob, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
    ci_vals <- pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)
    
    # Best cutpoint
    coords_best <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "all", best.method = "youden")
    if (is.data.frame(coords_best) && nrow(coords_best) > 1) {
      coords_best <- coords_best[which.max(coords_best$sensitivity), ]
    }
    thr <- as.numeric(coords_best[["threshold"]])
    pred <- ifelse(prob >= thr, 1, 0)
    
    TP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 1)
    TN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 0)
    FP <- sum(pred == 1 & df$outcome == 0)
    FN <- sum(pred == 0 & df$outcome == 1)
    
    ## --------- Cross-validation ---------
    folds <- sample(rep(1:n_folds, length.out = nrow(df)))
    aucs_cv <- map_dbl(1:n_folds, function(i) {
      train <- df[folds != i, ]
      test <- df[folds == i, ]
      if (length(unique(train$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(train$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_cv <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = train, family = binomial())
        prob_test <- predict(m_cv, newdata = test, type = "response")
        roc_cv <- pROC::roc(test$outcome, prob_test, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_cv))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    ## --------- Bootstrapping ---------
    aucs_boot <- map_dbl(1:n_boot, function(i) {
      boot_idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), replace = TRUE)
      df_boot <- df[boot_idx, ]
      if (length(unique(df_boot$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df_boot$Sex)) < 2) return(NA)
      tryCatch({
        m_boot <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df_boot, family = binomial())
        prob_boot <- predict(m_boot, type = "response")
        roc_boot <- pROC::roc(df_boot$outcome, prob_boot, levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
        as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_boot))
      }, error = function(e) NA)
    })
    
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_obj$auc),
      CI_Lower = ci_vals[1],
      CI_Upper = ci_vals[3],
      
      Sensitivity = coords_best[["sensitivity"]],
      Specificity = coords_best[["specificity"]],
      NPV = coords_best[["npv"]],
      PPV = coords_best[["ppv"]],
      Accuracy = (TP + TN) / (TP + TN + FP + FN),
      Cutpoint = thr,
      
      AUC_CV_Mean = mean(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_CV_SD   = sd(aucs_cv, na.rm = TRUE),
      
      AUC_Boot_Mean  = mean(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_SD    = sd(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Lower = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
      AUC_Boot_Upper = quantile(aucs_boot, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  })
}

# =============================================
# DeLong: Serum vs. CSF within each comparison
# (paired, because both fluids are measured on
#  the same matched subjects)
# Compares the adjusted models BD-Tau + Age + Sex
# =============================================

serum_vs_csf_delong <- function(data, cohort_var, pair) {
  df <- data %>%
    rename(cohort = !!rlang::sym(cohort_var)) %>%
    filter(cohort %in% pair) %>%
    mutate(
      outcome = as.numeric(cohort == pair[2]),
      Sex     = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female"))
    ) %>%
    # drop on BOTH biomarkers so the two ROCs are on identical cases (required for paired DeLong)
    drop_na(z_log2_serum_BDTau, z_log2_csf_BDTau, Age, Sex, outcome)
  
  if (length(unique(df$outcome)) < 2 || length(unique(df$Sex)) < 2 || nrow(df) < 5) {
    return(tibble(
      Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
      N = nrow(df), AUC_Serum = NA_real_, AUC_CSF = NA_real_,
      DeLong_Z = NA_real_, DeLong_P = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  m_serum <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_serum_BDTau + Age + Sex, data = df, family = binomial())
  m_csf   <- glm(outcome ~ z_log2_csf_BDTau   + Age + Sex, data = df, family = binomial())
  
  roc_serum <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, predict(m_serum, type = "response"),
                         levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
  roc_csf   <- pROC::roc(df$outcome, predict(m_csf,   type = "response"),
                         levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<")
  
  test <- pROC::roc.test(roc_serum, roc_csf, method = "delong", paired = TRUE)
  
  tibble(
    Comparison = paste(pair[2], "vs.", pair[1]),
    N          = nrow(df),
    AUC_Serum  = as.numeric(roc_serum$auc),
    AUC_CSF    = as.numeric(roc_csf$auc),
    DeLong_Z   = unname(test$statistic),
    DeLong_P   = test$p.value
  )
}

# Mirror the exact pairs/cohort vars used in the sections so labels match the forest plot
delong_specs <- list(
  list(cohort_var = "Cohort2", pair = c("SCI", "TBI")),          # -> "TBI vs. SCI"
  list(cohort_var = "Cohort",  pair = c("SCI", "Severe TBI")),   # -> "Severe TBI vs. SCI"
  list(cohort_var = "Cohort3", pair = c("B SCI",   "A SCI")),    # -> "A SCI vs. B SCI"
  list(cohort_var = "Cohort3", pair = c("C/D SCI", "A SCI")),    # -> "A SCI vs. C/D SCI"
  list(cohort_var = "Cohort3", pair = c("C/D SCI", "B SCI"))     # -> "B SCI vs. C/D SCI"
)

serum_vs_csf_delong_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  delong_specs,
  ~ serum_vs_csf_delong(match_roc_data, .x$cohort_var, .x$pair)
) %>%
  mutate(
    P_adj = p.adjust(DeLong_P, method = "BH"),   # optional: drop if you don't want multiplicity adjustment
    P_label = ifelse(DeLong_P < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", DeLong_P)),
    delta_AUC = AUC_Serum - AUC_CSF
  ) 

print(serum_vs_csf_delong_results)
```

```{r figure 3 supplementary table 2}
# load commercial bd-tau (TBI/SCI cohort)

commercial_bdtau <- bind_rows(
  tbi_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Subject.Visit, Cohort, Age, Sex, serum_BDTau, serum_Raw_Day_Value),
  sci_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Subject.Visit, Cohort, Age, Sex, serum_BDTau, serum_Raw_Day_Value), 
  cntr_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Subject.Visit, Cohort, Age, Sex, serum_BDTau, serum_Raw_Day_Value)) %>%
  mutate(Subject.Visit = ifelse(suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(Subject.Visit))), 
                                sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(Subject.Visit)), 
                                Subject.Visit %>%
                                  # Case 1: SP-01-####-C-XX → SP-01-####.C
                                  str_replace("^((?:SP-\\d+-\\d+))-(\\w)-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 2: ST-####-+CODE-XX → ST-####.CODE
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-\\+([A-Z0-9]+)-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 3: ST-####-CODE-XX → ST-####.CODE  (SCS, etc.)
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-([A-Z0-9]{2,})-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 4: ST-####-C-XX → ST-####.C
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-([A-Z])-.*$","\\1.\\2")
                                 )
    ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(serum_BDTau)) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID, Subject.Visit) %>%
  arrange(desc(!is.na(serum_Raw_Day_Value)), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # drop_na(all_of(bmkrs)) %>%
  mutate(Days_From_Injury = case_when(!is.na(`Time From Injury`) ~ `Time From Injury`/24,
                                      Cohort == 0 ~ 0,
                                      grepl("-A-", `Specimen ID`) ~ 0,
                                      grepl("-D-", `Specimen ID`) ~ 14,
                                      grepl(".B.", `Specimen ID`) ~ 90,
                                      grepl(".C.", `Specimen ID`) ~ 180),
        Subject.Visit = ifelse(suppressWarnings(!is.na(as.numeric(`Specimen ID`))), 
                                sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(`Specimen ID`)), 
                                `Specimen ID` %>%
                                  # Case 1: SP-01-####-C-XX → SP-01-####.C
                                  str_replace("^((?:SP-\\d+-\\d+))-(\\w)-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 2: ST-####-+CODE-XX → ST-####.CODE
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-\\+([A-Z0-9]+)-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 3: ST-####-CODE-XX → ST-####.CODE  (SCS, etc.)
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-([A-Z0-9]{2,})-.*$", "\\1.\\2") %>%
                                  # Case 4: ST-####-C-XX → ST-####.C
                                  str_replace("^([A-Z]+-\\d+)-([A-Z])-.*$","\\1.\\2")
                                 ),
         Subject.ID = case_when(
           # SP-01-1004-A-10S -> SP-1004
           str_detect(`Specimen ID`, "^SP-01-") ~
             str_replace(`Specimen ID`, "^SP-01-(\\d+).*", "SP-\\1"),
           
           # CTE-027-07S -> CTE-027
           str_detect(`Specimen ID`, "^CTE-") ~
             str_replace(`Specimen ID`, "^(CTE-\\d+).*", "\\1"),
           
           # MCS-1021-A-07S -> MCS-1021
           str_detect(`Specimen ID`, "^MCS-") ~
             str_replace(`Specimen ID`, "^(MCS-\\d+).*", "\\1"),
           
           # ST-1001-+36-09S -> ST-1001
           str_detect(`Specimen ID`, "^ST-") ~
           str_replace(`Specimen ID`, "^(ST-\\d+).*", "\\1"),
           
           TRUE ~ str_remove(`Specimen ID`, "\\..*$"))
    ) %>%
  rename(n4pd_BDtau_conc = `BD-tau_N4PD`) %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, Subject.Visit, `BD-tau (pg/ml)`, n4pd_BDtau_conc,
                GFAP_N4PD, NfL_N4PD, `UCH-L1_N4PD`)

bdtau_conc_baseline_roc <- bdtau_conc_baseline %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort3 = case_when(

# Function to perform ROC + CV + bootstrap

perform_roc <- function(data, group1, group2, predictor,
                        n_folds = 5, n_boot = 1000, seed = 42,
                        best_method = "youden") {
  
  set.seed(seed)
  
  df <- data %>%
    filter(cohort %in% c(group1, group2)) %>%
    mutate(outcome = ifelse(cohort == group2, 1L, 0L)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(c(predictor, "outcome")))
  
  if (dplyr::n_distinct(df$outcome) < 2) {
    return(list(
      roc = NA, coords = NA,
      auc = NA_real_, ci = c(NA_real_, NA_real_, NA_real_),
      n_group1 = sum(df$outcome == 0), n_group2 = sum(df$outcome == 1),
      confusion = c(TP = NA, FP = NA, TN = NA, FN = NA),
      cv = list(
        fold_table = tibble(),
        auc_mean = NA_real_, auc_sd = NA_real_,
        threshold_mean = NA_real_, threshold_sd = NA_real_,
        sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_, ppv = NA_real_, npv = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_
      ),
      boot = list(
        aucs = NA_real_,
        auc_mean = NA_real_, auc_sd = NA_real_,
        ci_lower = NA_real_, ci_upper = NA_real_
      )
    ))
  }

  # In-sample ROC + "best" threshold (descriptive)
  
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(
    response = df$outcome,
    predictor = df[[predictor]],
    levels = c(0, 1),
    direction = "auto",
    quiet = TRUE
  )
  
  auc_val <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))
  ci_val  <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj))
  
  coords_best <- pROC::coords(roc_obj, "best", ret = "all", best.method = best_method)
  coords_best <- as.data.frame(coords_best)
  if (nrow(coords_best) > 1) coords_best <- coords_best[which.max(coords_best$sensitivity), , drop = FALSE]
  thr <- as.numeric(coords_best$threshold)
  
  pred_pos <- ifelse(df[[predictor]] >= thr, 1L, 0L)
  
  tp <- sum(pred_pos == 1L & df$outcome == 1L)
  fp <- sum(pred_pos == 1L & df$outcome == 0L)
  tn <- sum(pred_pos == 0L & df$outcome == 0L)
  fn <- sum(pred_pos == 0L & df$outcome == 1L)
  
  sensitivity <- if ((tp + fn) > 0) tp / (tp + fn) else NA_real_
  specificity <- if ((tn + fp) > 0) tn / (tn + fp) else NA_real_
  ppv <- if ((tp + fp) > 0) tp / (tp + fp) else NA_real_
  npv <- if ((tn + fn) > 0) tn / (tn + fn) else NA_real_
  accuracy <- (tp + tn) / (tp + tn + fp + fn)
  
  coords_best$NPV <- npv
  coords_best$PPV <- ppv
  coords_best$Sensitivity <- sensitivity
  coords_best$Specificity <- specificity
  coords_best$Accuracy <- accuracy
  
  ## -------------------------
  ## Cross-validation
  ## - AUC on held-out folds
  ## - Threshold learned on TRAIN folds, applied to TEST folds (addresses "same set" concern)
  ## -------------------------
  
  folds <- sample(rep(seq_len(n_folds), length.out = nrow(df)))
  
  cv_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_len(n_folds), function(k) {
    train <- df[folds != k, , drop = FALSE]
    test <- df[folds == k, , drop = FALSE]
    
    if (nrow(test) == 0 || dplyr::n_distinct(train$outcome) < 2 || dplyr::n_distinct(test$outcome) < 2) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        fold = k, auc = NA_real_, threshold = NA_real_,
        sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_, ppv = NA_real_, npv = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    roc_train <- tryCatch(
      pROC::roc(train$outcome, train[[predictor]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(roc_train)) {
      return(tibble::tibble(
        fold = k, auc = NA_real_, threshold = NA_real_,
        sensitivity = NA_real_, specificity = NA_real_, ppv = NA_real_, npv = NA_real_, accuracy = NA_real_
      ))
    }
    
    cb <- pROC::coords(roc_train, "best", ret = "all", best.method = best_method)
    cb <- as.data.frame(cb)
    if (nrow(cb) > 1) cb <- cb[which.max(cb$sensitivity), , drop = FALSE]
    thr_k <- as.numeric(cb$threshold)
    
    roc_test <- tryCatch(
      pROC::roc(test$outcome, test[[predictor]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    auc_k <- if (is.null(roc_test)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_test))
    
    pred_k <- ifelse(test[[predictor]] >= thr_k, 1L, 0L)
    tp_k <- sum(pred_k == 1L & test$outcome == 1L)
    fp_k <- sum(pred_k == 1L & test$outcome == 0L)
    tn_k <- sum(pred_k == 0L & test$outcome == 0L)
    fn_k <- sum(pred_k == 0L & test$outcome == 1L)
    
    sens_k <- if ((tp_k + fn_k) > 0) tp_k / (tp_k + fn_k) else NA_real_
    spec_k <- if ((tn_k + fp_k) > 0) tn_k / (tn_k + fp_k) else NA_real_
    ppv_k <- if ((tp_k + fp_k) > 0) tp_k / (tp_k + fp_k) else NA_real_
    npv_k <- if ((tn_k + fn_k) > 0) tn_k / (tn_k + fn_k) else NA_real_
    acc_k <- (tp_k + tn_k) / (tp_k + tn_k + fp_k + fn_k)
    
    tibble::tibble(
      fold = k,
      auc = auc_k,
      threshold = thr_k,
      sensitivity = sens_k,
      specificity = spec_k,
      ppv = ppv_k,
      npv = npv_k,
      accuracy = acc_k
    )
  })
  
  cv_auc_mean <- mean(cv_tbl$auc, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_auc_sd <- sd(cv_tbl$auc, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cv_thr_mean <- mean(cv_tbl$threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_thr_sd <- sd(cv_tbl$threshold, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cv_sens <- mean(cv_tbl$sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_spec <- mean(cv_tbl$specificity, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_ppv <- mean(cv_tbl$ppv, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_npv <- mean(cv_tbl$npv, na.rm = TRUE)
  cv_acc <- mean(cv_tbl$accuracy, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Bootstrap (AUC distribution + percentile CI)

  aucs_boot <- purrr::map_dbl(seq_len(n_boot), function(b) {
    idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(df)), replace = TRUE)
    d_b <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]
    if (dplyr::n_distinct(d_b$outcome) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    
    roc_b <- tryCatch(
      pROC::roc(d_b$outcome, d_b[[predictor]], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "auto", quiet = TRUE),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(roc_b)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_b))
  })
  
  boot_mean <- mean(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE)
  boot_sd <- sd(aucs_boot, na.rm = TRUE)
  boot_lower <- as.numeric(quantile(aucs_boot, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE))
  boot_upper <- as.numeric(quantile(aucs_boot, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
  
  list(
    roc = roc_obj,
    coords = coords_best,
    auc = auc_val,
    ci = ci_val,
    n_group1 = sum(df$outcome == 0),
    n_group2 = sum(df$outcome == 1),
    confusion = c(TP = tp, FP = fp, TN = tn, FN = fn),
    
    cv = list(
      fold_table = cv_tbl,
      auc_mean = cv_auc_mean,
      auc_sd = cv_auc_sd,
      threshold_mean = cv_thr_mean,
      threshold_sd   = cv_thr_sd,
      sensitivity = cv_sens,
      specificity = cv_spec,
      ppv = cv_ppv,
      npv = cv_npv,
      accuracy = cv_acc
    ),
    
    boot = list(
      aucs = aucs_boot,
      auc_mean = boot_mean,
      auc_sd = boot_sd,
      ci_lower = boot_lower,
      ci_upper = boot_upper
    )
  )
}

## =========================================================
## Define comparisons
## =========================================================

comparisons <- list(
  list(name = "TBI vs. Control", group1 = "Control", group2 = "TBI"),
  list(name = "TBI vs. SCI", group1 = "SCI", group2 = "TBI"),
  list(name = "SCI vs. Control", group1 = "Control", group2 = "SCI")
)

# Loop through all biomarkers and comparisons

bmkrs <- c("commercial_BDtau_conc", "GFAP_N4PD", "NfL_N4PD", "UCH_L1_N4PD")

results_list <- list()
roc_objects <- list()

for (bmkr in bmkrs) {
  roc_objects[[bmkr]] <- list()
  
  for (comp in comparisons) {
    roc_result <- perform_roc(
      bdtau_conc_baseline_roc %>% rename(cohort = Cohort2), 
      comp$group2, comp$group1, bmkr)
    
    # Store ROC object for DeLong tests
    roc_objects[[bmkr]][[comp$name]] <- roc_result$roc
    
    # Store results
    temp_results <- data.frame(
      Biomarker = bmkr,
      Comparison = comp$name,
      N1 = roc_result$n_group1,
      N2= roc_result$n_group2,
      AUC = as.numeric(roc_result$auc),
      CI_Lower = roc_result$ci[1],
      CI_Upper = roc_result$ci[3],
      NPV = roc_result$coords$npv, 
      PPV = roc_result$coords$ppv, 
      Sensitivity = roc_result$coords$sensitivity,
      Specificity = roc_result$coords$specificity
    )
    
    results_list[[paste(bmkr, comp$name, sep = "_")]] <- temp_results
  }
}

# Combine all results
all_roc_results <- bind_rows(results_list)

all_roc_results_forest <- all_roc_results %>%
  filter(Biomarker != "n4pd_BDtau_conc")

# Perform DeLong tests comparing biomarkers within each comparison

delong_results <- list()

for (comp in comparisons) {
  comp_name <- comp$name
  
  # Get all biomarker combinations
  bmkr_combos <- combn(bmkrs, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  for (combo in bmkr_combos) {
    bmkr1 <- combo[1]
    bmkr2 <- combo[2]
    
    # Get AUC values
    auc1 <- as.numeric(auc(roc_objects[[bmkr1]][[comp_name]]))
    auc2 <- as.numeric(auc(roc_objects[[bmkr2]][[comp_name]]))
    
    # Perform DeLong test
    delong_test <- roc.test(
      roc_objects[[bmkr1]][[comp_name]], 
      roc_objects[[bmkr2]][[comp_name]], 
      method = "delong"
    )
    
    delong_results[[paste(comp_name, bmkr1, bmkr2, sep = "_")]] <- data.frame(
      Comparison = comp_name,
      Biomarker1 = bmkr1,
      Biomarker2 = bmkr2,
      AUC1 = round(auc1, 3),
      AUC2 = round(auc2, 3),
      Difference = round(auc1 - auc2, 3),
      Z_statistic = round(delong_test$statistic, 3),
      P_value = delong_test$p.value,
      P_formatted = format.pval(delong_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001),
      Significant = ifelse(delong_test$p.value < 0.05, "Yes", "No")
    )
  }
}

# Combine DeLong results

all_delong_results <- bind_rows(delong_results) %>%
  mutate(delta_AUC = AUC1 - AUC2)

library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# Color palette per biomarker

biomarker_colors <- c(
  "commercial_BDtau_conc" = "#DA4D3F",
  "GFAP_N4PD" = "#4D3F8D",
  "NfL_N4PD" = "#E8B402",
  "UCH_L1_N4PD" = "#007F47"
)

biomarker_labels <- c(
  "commercial_BDtau_conc" = "BD-Tau",
  "GFAP_N4PD" = "GFAP",
  "NfL_N4PD" = "NfL",
  "UCH_L1_N4PD" = "UCH-L1"
)

# Build one plot per comparison

comparison_names <- c("TBI vs. Control", "TBI vs. SCI", "SCI vs. Control")

plot_list <- list()

for (comp_name in comparison_names) {
  
  curve_data <- list()
  label_lines <- c()
  
  for (bmkr in bmkrs) {
    
    roc_obj <- roc_objects[[bmkr]][[comp_name]]
    if (is.null(roc_obj)) next
    
    auc_val <- as.numeric(auc(roc_obj))
    ci_val <- ci.auc(roc_obj, conf.level = 0.95)
    
    # ROC curve as data frame (1 - specificity vs sensitivity)
    curve_data[[bmkr]] <- data.frame(
      fpr = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
      tpr = roc_obj$sensitivities,
      Biomarker = biomarker_labels[[bmkr]]
    )
    
    label_lines[bmkr] <- sprintf(
      "%s  AUC = %.2f (%.2f–%.2f)",
      biomarker_labels[[bmkr]], auc_val, ci_val[1], ci_val[3]
    )
  }
  
  all_curves <- bind_rows(curve_data)
  
  # Map display labels to colors
  color_map <- setNames(
    biomarker_colors[bmkrs],
    biomarker_labels[bmkrs]
  )
  
  p <- ggplot(all_curves, aes(x = fpr, y = tpr, color = Biomarker)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = color_map,
      labels = label_lines[bmkrs],   # AUC labels in legend
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0), limits = c(0, 1),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0), limits = c(0, 1),
                       labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = comp_name,
      x = "1 – Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
      y = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = c(0.62, 0.18),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.85),
                                       color = "grey80", linewidth = 0.4),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10, family = "mono"),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.6, "lines"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12)
    )
  
  plot_list[[comp_name]] <- p
}

plot_list$`TBI vs. SCI`



biomarker_shapes <- c(
  "commercial_BDtau_conc" = 16,  # circle
  "GFAP_N4PD" = 17,  # triangle
  "NfL_N4PD" = 15,  # square
  "UCH_L1_N4PD" = 18   # diamond
)
biomarker_lty <- c(
  "commercial_BDtau_conc" = "solid",
  "GFAP_N4PD" = "dashed",
  "NfL_N4PD" = "dotdash",
  "UCH_L1_N4PD" = "longdash"
)

# bottom-to-top order so BD-Tau ends up on top
bm_order <- c("UCH_L1_N4PD", "NfL_N4PD", "GFAP_N4PD", "commercial_BDtau_conc")

# ---- data ----
forest_tbisci <- all_roc_results_forest %>%
  filter(Comparison == "TBI vs. SCI") %>%
  mutate(Biomarker = factor(Biomarker, levels = bm_order))

# numeric y position of each biomarker (discrete axis maps to 1..n)
ypos <- setNames(seq_along(bm_order), bm_order)

# ---- ΔAUC brackets (BD-Tau vs each comparator) ----
bdtau_auc <- forest_tbisci$AUC[forest_tbisci$Biomarker == "commercial_BDtau_conc"]

delong_tbisci <- all_delong_results %>% filter(Comparison == "TBI vs. SCI")

# p-value lookup: comparator biomarker -> DeLong p vs BD-Tau
delong_p <- setNames(delong_tbisci$P_value, delong_tbisci$Biomarker2)

# format to 2 significant figures (e.g. 0.0011, 6.7e-06, 0.0015)
fmt_p <- function(p) formatC(signif(p, 2), format = "g", digits = 2)

bracket_df <- forest_tbisci %>%
  filter(Biomarker != "commercial_BDtau_conc") %>%
  transmute(
    Biomarker = as.character(Biomarker),
    y_top = ypos["commercial_BDtau_conc"],
    y_bot = ypos[as.character(Biomarker)],
    dAUC  = bdtau_auc - AUC,
    label = sprintf("\u0394AUC=%.2f, p=%s", dAUC, fmt_p(delong_p[as.character(Biomarker)]))
  ) %>%
  # innermost bracket (shortest span, GFAP) leftmost; outermost (UCH-L1) rightmost
  arrange(desc(y_bot)) %>%
  mutate(xpos = 0.98 + (row_number() - 1) * 0.075)

tick <- 0.012
add_bracket <- function(d) {
  list(
    annotate("segment", x = d$xpos, xend = d$xpos, y = d$y_bot, yend = d$y_top, linewidth = 0.5),
    annotate("segment", x = d$xpos, xend = d$xpos - tick, y = d$y_top, yend = d$y_top, linewidth = 0.5),
    annotate("segment", x = d$xpos, xend = d$xpos - tick, y = d$y_bot, yend = d$y_bot, linewidth = 0.5),
    annotate("text", x = d$xpos + 0.012, y = (d$y_top + d$y_bot) / 2,
             label = d$label, angle = -90, size = 4)
  )
}
bracket_layers <- do.call(c, lapply(seq_len(nrow(bracket_df)),
                                    function(i) add_bracket(bracket_df[i, ])))

p <- ggplot(forest_tbisci, aes(x = AUC, y = Biomarker,
                               color = Biomarker, shape = Biomarker, linetype = Biomarker)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = CI_Lower, xmax = CI_Upper), height = 0, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  bracket_layers +
  scale_color_manual(values = biomarker_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = biomarker_shapes) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = biomarker_lty) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = biomarker_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.33, 1.22), breaks = seq(0.4, 1.0, 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Adjusted AUC (95% CI)", y = NULL, tag = "b", title = "TBI vs. SCI") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )

print(p)
```

```{r figure 4 supplementary table 3}
# ============================================
# Serum Cohort: Longitudinal Spaghetti Plots with Control
# Panel A: Control vs. SCI vs. TBI (3-group)
# Panel B: Control vs. Subgroups (Moderate/Severe TBI + ASIA SCI)
# Note: Control excluded from mixed-effects models
# ============================================

library(lme4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(data.table)

# ============================================
# PREPARE DATA - SERUM COHORT WITH CONTROL
# ============================================

# ASIA IDs for SCI subgroups
asia_a_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "A", ]$Subject.ID

asia_b_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA == "B", ]$Subject.ID

asia_cd_ids <- sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned[
  !is.na(sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA) & 
    sci_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$ASIA %in% c("C","D"), ]$Subject.ID

# Get intersection of variables
intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  names(cntr),
  names(sci_serum_demo),
  names(tbi_serum_demo)
))

serum_cleaned <- rbindlist(
  list(
    cntr %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    sci_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)),
    tbi_serum_demo %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
  ),
  use.names = TRUE,
  fill = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% serum_baseline_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("Control", "SCI", "Mild TBI", "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
    # 3-group classification (exclude Mild TBI)
    Cohort3 = factor(
      case_when(
        Cohort == "Control" ~ "Control",
        Cohort == "SCI" ~ "SCI",
        Cohort %in% c("Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI") ~ "TBI",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ), 
      levels = c("Control", "SCI", "TBI")
    ),
    # Subgroup classification
    Cohort_Subgroup = case_when(
      Cohort == "Control" ~ "Control",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_a_ids ~ "A SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_b_ids ~ "B SCI",
      !is.na(Subject.ID) & Subject.ID %in% asia_cd_ids ~ "C/D SCI",
      Cohort == "Moderate TBI" ~ "Moderate TBI",
      Cohort == "Severe TBI" ~ "Severe TBI",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Cohort)
    ),
    Cohort_Subgroup = factor(Cohort_Subgroup, 
                             levels = c("Control", "A SCI", "B SCI", "C/D SCI", 
                                        "Moderate TBI", "Severe TBI")),
    # Set Control timepoint to 0
    serum_First_Digit_12Hr = case_when(
      Cohort == "Control" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ serum_First_Digit_12Hr
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline =
           serum_First_Digit_12Hr -
           min(serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3) | !is.na(Cohort_Subgroup))  # Keep valid subjects

# Color palettes
color_3group <- c(
  "Control" = "black",
  "SCI" = "#07668d", 
  "TBI" = "#813405"
)

color_subgroup <- c(
  "Control" = "black",
  "A SCI" = "#007382",
  "B SCI" = "#019787",
  "C/D SCI" = "#82e1cd",
  "Moderate TBI" = "#f9a03f",
  "Severe TBI" = "#d45113"
)

# PANEL A: Control vs. SCI vs. TBI (3-group)

# Filter to first 12 timepoints (0-144 hours)

  mutate(time_since_baseline = as.numeric(time_since_baseline)) %>%
  filter(time_since_baseline <= 12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Cohort3))

# Prepare plot data
plot_data_3group <- dd_3group %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_since_baseline), !is.na(serum_BDTau)) %>%

    group = Cohort3,

    subject = as.factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Summarize mean ± SE
summary_3group <- plot_data_3group %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean_val = base::mean(serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    sd_val = stats::sd(serum_BDTau, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(se_val = sd_val / sqrt(n))

# Count unique subjects per group
group_counts_3group <- plot_data_3group %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject.ID, group) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  dplyr::count(group) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(group, " (N=", n, ")"))

# Mixed-effects model for statistics - EXCLUDE CONTROL
plot_data_3group_no_control <- plot_data_3group %>%
  filter(group != "Control")

lmm_3group <- lmer(serum_log2_BDTau ~ group * time_hours + (1 | subject), 
                   data = plot_data_3group_no_control)
anova_3group <- anova(lmm_3group)

cat("\n=== PANEL A: 3-GROUP MODEL (EXCLUDING CONTROL) ===\n")
print(anova_3group)
cat("\n")

# Per-timepoint statistics - EXCLUDE CONTROL
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

tp_pvals_3group <- plot_data_3group_no_control %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_hours), !is.na(group), !is.na(serum_log2_BDTau)) %>%
  group_by(time_hours) %>%
  group_modify(~{
    dat <- .x
    
    n_by_group <- dat %>% count(group, name = "n") %>%
      mutate(group = as.character(group))
    
    if (n_distinct(dat$group) < 2) {
      out <- tibble(p = NA_real_, test = "kruskal")
    } else {
      out <- tibble(
        p = kruskal.test(serum_log2_BDTau ~ group, data = dat)$p.value,
        test = "kruskal"
      )
    }
    
    out %>%
      bind_cols(
        n_by_group %>%
          pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = n, names_prefix = "n_")
      )
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))
```

```{r supplementary table 4}

## ============================================================
## Serum BD-Tau Longitudinal Trajectory: Favorable vs Unfavorable GOS (3 months)
##
## Compares serum BD-Tau trajectories (log2 scale) between subjects with
## Favorable vs Unfavorable outcome (GOS at 3 months), with Controls shown
## for visual reference only (excluded from statistical models).
##
## Inputs (expected in the calling environment / project data folder):
##   - tbi_serum_demo             : long-format serum data per subject/timepoint
##   - tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned  : subject IDs with valid baseline data
##   - cntr                       : control subject data
##
## Outputs:
##   - <results_path>/serum_3mo_GOS_pairwise_analysis.xlsx
##   - <figures_path>/serum_bdtau_by_GOS_fav_vs_unfav_3mo.pdf
## ============================================================

library(mgcv)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(writexl)

outcome_col <- "GOS_03"
time_col <- "time_since_baseline"
y_col <- "mean_serum_BDTau"
log_y_col <- "mean_serum_log2_BDTau"

outcome_colors <- c(
  "Control" = "grey50",
  "Favorable" = "#3594cc",
  "Unfavorable" = "#ea801c"
)

outcome_linetypes <- c(
  "Control" = "solid",
  "Favorable" = "solid",
  "Unfavorable" = "dotdash"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepare data
# ------------------------------------------------------------

serum_cleaned <- tbi_serum_demo %>%
  filter(Subject.ID %in% tbi_serum_demo_BL_cleaned$Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(serum_First_Digit_24Hr = trunc(serum_First_Digit_12Hr / 2)) %>%
  group_by(Subject.ID) %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline = serum_First_Digit_12Hr - min(serum_First_Digit_12Hr, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(baseline_time))

# Add control group (treated as time 0 for plotting reference)
cntr_ref <- cntr %>%
  mutate(time_since_baseline = 0, GOS_03 = "Control")

intersect_vars <- intersect(colnames(cntr_ref), colnames(serum_cleaned))

dd <- bind_rows(
  serum_cleaned %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars)) %>% filter(time_since_baseline <= 12),
  cntr_ref %>% dplyr::select(all_of(intersect_vars))
)

stopifnot(all(c("Subject.ID", time_col, y_col, log_y_col, outcome_col) %in% names(dd)))

plot_data <- data.frame(
  Subject.ID = dd$Subject.ID,
  group_raw = dplyr::recode(dd[[outcome_col]], "Dead" = "Deceased"),
  time = as.numeric(dd[[time_col]]),
  time_hours = as.numeric(dd[[time_col]]) * 12,
  y_raw = dd[[y_col]],
  y_log2 = dd[[log_y_col]],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(group_raw), group_raw %in% c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable"),
    !is.na(time), !is.na(y_raw), !is.na(y_log2)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group_raw, levels = c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable")),
    subject = factor(Subject.ID)
  )

# Mixed effects model (Favorable vs Unfavorable only; Control excluded)

plot_data_model <- plot_data %>%
  filter(group != "Control") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Favorable", "Unfavorable")))

interaction_p <- NA_real_

if (nrow(plot_data_model) >= 10 && dplyr::n_distinct(plot_data_model$group) >= 2) {
  
  lmm <- lmerTest::lmer(y_log2 ~ group * time + (1 | subject), data = plot_data_model)
  coef_table <- summary(lmm)$coefficients
  
  if ("groupUnfavorable:time" %in% rownames(coef_table)) {
    interaction_p <- coef_table["groupUnfavorable:time", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  }
  
  message("Group x time interaction p = ", format.pval(interaction_p, digits = 4))
}

n_favorable   <- sum(plot_data_model$group == "Favorable", na.rm = TRUE)
n_unfavorable <- sum(plot_data_model$group == "Unfavorable", na.rm = TRUE)

# Per-timepoint pairwise comparisons (Wilcoxon on log2 scale, BH-adjusted)

all_groups <- c("Control", "Favorable", "Unfavorable")
pairwise_comparisons <- combn(all_groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
unique_times <- sort(unique(plot_data$time_hours))

pairwise_results <- map_dfr(unique_times, function(time_pt) {
  
  time_data <- plot_data %>% filter(time_hours == time_pt)
  
  map_dfr(pairwise_comparisons, function(pair) {
    
    data1 <- time_data$y_log2[time_data$group == pair[1]]
    data2 <- time_data$y_log2[time_data$group == pair[2]]
    n1 <- length(data1); n2 <- length(data2)
    
    if (n1 >= 2 && n2 >= 2) {
      test_result <- try(wilcox.test(data1, data2, exact = FALSE), silent = TRUE)
      p_val <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA_real_ else test_result$p.value
      test_stat <- if (inherits(test_result, "try-error")) NA_real_ else unname(test_result$statistic)
    } else {
      p_val <- NA_real_
      test_stat <- NA_real_
    }
    
    tibble(
      time_hours = time_pt,
      group1 = pair[1], group2 = pair[2],
      n1 = n1, n2 = n2,
      test_statistic = test_stat,
      p_raw = p_val,
      comparison = paste0(pair[1], " vs ", pair[2])
    )
  })
}) %>%
  group_by(group1, group2) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj = p.adjust(p_raw, method = "BH"),
    sig_adj = case_when(
      p_adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p_adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p_adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Save statistical results

interaction_summary <- tibble(
  GOS_Timepoint = "3 months",
  N_Favorable = n_favorable,
  N_Unfavorable = n_unfavorable,
  Interaction_FavVsUnfav_p = interaction_p
)

# Visualization 

summary_df <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(group, time_hours) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_val = mean(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_val = sd(y_raw, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sig_markers <- pairwise_results %>%
  filter(group1 == "Favorable", group2 == "Unfavorable", sig_adj != "ns") %>%
  select(time_hours, sig_adj)

y_star <- max(summary_df$mean_val + summary_df$se_val, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.10

serum_plot <- ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = time_hours, y = mean_val, color = group)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group, linetype = group), linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_val - se_val, ymax = mean_val + se_val),
                width = 2, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = outcome_colors, name = NULL) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = outcome_linetypes, guide = "none") +
  geom_text(
    data = sig_markers,
    aes(x = time_hours, y = y_star, label = sig_adj),
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 5, fontface = "bold", color = "black"
  ) +
  labs(title = "3 months", x = "Hours Post-Injury", y = "Serum BD-Tau (pg/mL)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 144, by = 24)) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 9),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8)
  )

print(serum_plot)

```
